title: Verify: Second NPC scene parses and validates unit tests
summary: Unit tests for schema and validateWorld acceptance of a second NPC
description: Write game/tests/npcSceneValid.test.ts with in-memory scene and world, no fs.

steps.action: Build a scene object with characters boy and npc (position, scale 1, layer characters, idle animation ref character:npc/idle), call sceneSchema.safeParse and assert success true and data.characters length 2.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/npcSceneValid.test.ts -t "schema parses"

steps.action: Call validateWorld with world.characters [boy, npc] and the same scene cast to SceneDef inside scenes; assert result toEqual [].
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/npcSceneValid.test.ts -t "validateWorld accepts"
steps.expected: Test passes with empty error array
